feedbackModal.title: Feedback
feedbackModal.description: Please share your opinions and requests for improving this app. When you submit, a GitHub Issue page opens in a new tab already prefilled with your feedback (your text is also copied to the clipboard as a backup).

categories.resources: Add study resources (BlackBelt, official docs, etc.)

feedbackModal.contentPlaceholder: Please describe improvements or features you'd like within 1000 characters.
feedbackModal.imageAdd: Add images (click, or paste / drop here)
feedbackModal.imageHelp: Attached images cannot be sent through the prefilled GitHub form. After the issue page opens, paste the image(s) directly into the issue body to upload them.
feedbackModal.noAccountNote: Pressing "Submit" opens GitHub's prefilled issue page, and you must sign in to a GitHub account to post it there. If you don't have or don't want a GitHub account, press "Copy text" below and send it any way you like (e.g. to the developer). You can also browse existing feedback without signing in.
feedbackModal.browseIssues: Browse existing issues (no sign-in needed to view)
feedbackModal.copied: Your feedback was copied to the clipboard. Send it however you like.
feedbackModal.copyFailed: Copy failed. Please select and copy the text manually.
feedbackModal.sent: The issue page opened in a new tab. Please review and submit.
feedbackModal.sentWithImages: The issue page opened in a new tab. Please paste your image(s) into the issue body, then submit.
feedbackModal.directDescription: Please share your opinions and requests for improving this app. Press "Send" and it reaches the developer directly — no GitHub account needed (it is filed as a public GitHub Issue).
feedbackModal.directNote: Submissions are posted as public GitHub Issues (attached images are public too). Make sure no personal information or API keys are visible. To post with your own GitHub account, use "Post on GitHub".
feedbackModal.directImageHelp: Up to 3 images are sent along with your feedback (they are resized on your device first, and metadata such as location is removed).
feedbackModal.sentDirect: Sent. Thank you for your feedback!
feedbackModal.sentDirectImagesSkipped: Sent ({{count}} image(s) could not be included). Thank you for your feedback!
feedbackModal.sendFailed: Could not send. Please try again later, or use "Post on GitHub" or "Copy text".
feedbackModal.sendRateLimited: Too many submissions in a short time. Please wait about 10 minutes and try again.
